hooks.name: Check workflow gates after agent stop
hooks.description: After each agent turn, runs ubc agent gaps to check whether any workflow trace gates are still open and reports the result into context.

action.command: cd "$(git -C "$(dirname "$0")" rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)" && if command -v ubc &>/dev/null && [ -f docs/ubproject.toml -o -f ubproject.toml ]; then PROJECT=$([ -f docs/ubproject.toml ] && echo "docs" || echo "."); ubc agent gaps -p "$PROJECT" 2>&1 && echo "✓ Workflow gates green" || echo "⚠ Workflow gaps remain — run /ubc-agent-next to advance"; fi
